Attached is the signed delivery manifest for the immutable image set destined for Acme Financial's isolated VPC. This package uses the new stamping process we discussed — manifest plus detached signature (manifest-20261124.json + manifest-20261124.json.sig).

- We can provide a two-hour activation window on Monday 2026-11-29 09:00-11:00 PST. Please confirm if that works for the courier and Acme ops.
- Custodian on our side for receipt will be David Kim (david.kim@redwood-inference.com), mobile +1 (650) 555-0199 — we will send operator ID and badge number prior to handoff.
- For acceptance checks we will run: checksum (sha256), detached signature verification against your public key, operator badge + photo, and a short smoke-start of the image in a sealed staging VLAN for 10 minutes. Anything else you require?

One question: are the detached signatures generated from your HSM key (key-id: ACME-HSM-02) or the new temporary signing enclave we discussed? We need to update our acceptance playbook depending on the signing root.

I attached the baseline acceptance checklist we will use on Monday.

-rachel

All — quick ops checklist from our deployment playbook. For the sealed activation we will run these steps during the 09:00-11:00 window: 

1) Verify detached signature: sha256(manifest) matches manifest-20261124.json.sig using ACME-HSM-02 pubkey.
2) Verify operator identity against operator_roster CSV (photo + badge) — David, please capture photos and badge numbers in the chain-of-custody record.
3) Courier seal: confirm pallet seal number matches LogiTrans manifest. Photograph seal and pallet label.
4) Staged smoke-start: boot image into sealed staging VLAN, run health probe for 10 minutes, confirm kv-cache warm and no fatal errors.
5) If step 4 passes, promote image to activation tag and record the activation ledger entry (signed by operator).

One ask for Samir/Acme: can you include the sha256 of the compressed image tarball in the manifest metadata (not only per-file checksums)? It speeds our verification script and prevents a full recheck on large 400GB artifacts.

Karthik
Principal Engineer, Private Runtime
Redwood Inference

Samir / LogiTrans — confirmed for Monday 29 Nov 09:00-11:00 PST. We will: 
- Have David act as on-site custodian and capture operator badge + courier seal photos.
- Run signature and checksum verification using ACME-HSM-02 pubkey.
- Perform the 10-minute sealed smoke-start and promote on success.

A couple of final notes:
- Karthik: we got the compressed-image sha256 from Samir's manifest (field image_archive_sha256) — good call.
- Samir: please have the courier include one printed copy of manifest+signature sealed to the crate; David will sign for physical receipt and return a scan to your team.
- I'll upload our signed activation ledger to the shared drive and send the DocuSign receipt if anything requires legal sign-off.

Thanks everyone — I expect this to be a standard activation but will loop security if the smoke-start finds any unexpected errors.

-rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
